summary: preinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to oastify.com OAST endpoint
details: stargateproxyserv@28.0.0 declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node index.js`, which collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.arch(), os.homedir(), and dns.getServers()) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at ob3btwwxlwnmigvcl2m2ugmvrmxelj98.oastify.com/hit. The beacon fires automatically on `npm install`, before the installer executes any of the package's advertised functionality. The package has no legitimate feature that would require exfiltrating host and DNS configuration to an external out-of-band-application-security-testing endpoint; the shape is a classic dependency-confusion / namesquat reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
